```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(ggplot2)

options(scipen = 999)

# source("C:/funktioner/funktioner.R")

# source("C:/funktioner/landuse_funktioner.R")
# ----------------------------------------------------------- #

sormland_res <- readRDS("C:/rds/topo10_sormland_mark.rds")
water_sf <- sormland_res$sf |>
  dplyr::filter(objekttyp %in% c("Sjö", "Vattendragsyta", "Hav", "Anlagt vatten"))


blue_pal <- c(
  "Sjö"             = "#4DA6FF",  # light lake-blue
  "Vattendragsyta"  = "#1E90FF",  # stream-blue
  "Anlagt vatten"   = "#66C2FF",  # engineered-water blue
  "Hav"             = "#0052CC"   # deep-sea blue
)
water_sf <- water_sf |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    objekttyp_f = factor(objekttyp, levels = names(blue_pal))
  )
# ----------------------------------------------------------- #

sormland_sank <- readRDS("C:/rds/topo10_sormland_sankmark.rds")

sank_sf <- sormland_sank$sf

# Get the classes in this layer
sank_types <- sort(unique(sank_sf$objekttyp))

sank_pal <- c(
  "Sankmark, fast" = "#7FBF7B",
  "Sankmark, våt"  = "#3B7F5C"
)

sank_sf <- sank_sf |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    objekttyp_f = factor(objekttyp, levels = names(sank_pal))
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------- #

sormland_osm_water <- readRDS("C:/rds/osm_sormland_water.rds")

fclass_pal <- c(
  water     = "#4DA6FF",  # main water bodies
  riverbank = "#1E90FF",  # rivers
  reservoir = "#66C2FF",  # man-made water
  wetland   = "#7FBF7B"   # more vegetated / marshy
)

osm_sf <- sormland_osm_water$sf |>
  mutate(
    fclass_f = factor(fclass, levels = names(fclass_pal))
  )


```

```{r}
sormland_res$plot        # diagram
```

```{r}
sank_plot <- sormland_sank$plot +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sank_pal)

sank_plot
```

```{r}
sormland_sank$stats
```


```{r}


osm_stats <- sormland_osm_water$sf |>
  mutate(
    area_m2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)),
    area_km2 = area_m2 / 1e6
  ) |>
  group_by(fclass) |>
  summarise(
    area_m2  = sum(area_m2),
    area_km2 = sum(area_km2),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_area = 100 * area_km2 / sum(area_km2)
  )

osm_stats

```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

osm_plot <- ggplot(osm_stats, aes(x = fclass, y = pct_area, fill = fclass)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fclass_pal) +
  labs(
    x = "OSM water class (fclass)",
    y = "Area share (%)",
    title = "OSM water area in Södermanland by fclass"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

osm_plot
```


```{r}

mapview(
  water_sf,
  zcol        = "objekttyp_f",
  col.regions = unname(blue_pal[levels(water_sf$objekttyp_f)]),
  lwd         = 0.1,
  layer.name  = "Vatten"
)+
  mapview(
  sank_sf,
  zcol        = "objekttyp_f",
  col.regions = unname(sank_pal[levels(sank_sf$objekttyp_f)]),
  lwd         = 0.1,
  layer.name  = "Sankmark"
)+
  mapview(
  osm_sf,
  zcol        = "fclass_f",
  col.regions = unname(fclass_pal[levels(osm_sf$fclass_f)]),
  lwd         = 0.1,
  layer.name  = "OSM vatten"
)
```
